overview: Tenebrous Mountains is the central wilderness frontier of Luclin, a region where resonance instability, nocturnal predators, and faction warfare converge. It serves as the connective tissue between the Umbral Plains, Maiden’s Eye, Sanctus Seru, and the deeper caverns of Luclin.
history: Formed from ancient volcanic uplift and long-term Umbral erosion, the Tenebrous Mountains became a natural barrier between the Umbral Plains and the rest of Luclin.
Razorfiend broods claimed the cliffs and hollows as apex predators long before organized factions arrived.
Lightcrawlers evolved in holy-charged caverns, becoming nocturnal bioluminescent hunters tied to ancient Luclin resonance.
Vampyric Courts extended their influence into the Depths, establishing throne chambers and blood-ritual sanctums.
Shadowed Akheva ritualists breached the region seeking to weaponize resonance and shadow energy.
Umbral Vanguard forces established patrol routes and stabilizer pylons to contain storms and prevent planar collapse.
regionHooks: A major resonance storm threatens to spill from the Tenebrous Depths into the Borderlands.
A Razorfiend brood expansion destabilizes travel routes between Cliffs and Ridge.
Lightcrawler mutations in the Pits suggest a new holy resonance source deeper below.
Umbral Vanguard scouts seek allies to confront a tri-faction crisis in the Depths.
Akhevan ritualists attempt to open a shadow breach linking Tenebrous to Akheva Ruins.
